id.description: The entry's slug, equal to its file name's stem, providers/<id>.json (docs/specification/provider.md#rulings-dec-0017).

providerId.description: The provider.id of the manifest this entry names, a URI (docs/specification/provider.md#rulings-dec-0017).

name.description: The provider's name as a person reads it, 1 to 80 characters.

summary.description: One line on what the provider does, up to 200 characters.

manifest.description: The local path of the provider's manifest, a file named fabric-agent.json after either separator, so a Windows path (DEC-0032) names it too (DEC-0145; docs/specification/provider.md#what-the-schema-adds-to-the-table).

run.description: How a host starts or reaches the provider's MCP server (docs/specification/provider.md#what-the-schema-adds-to-the-table).

mcp.description: Either a stdio server or a loopback URL; the branch is chosen by the presence of stdio, so a mistake reports that branch's errors only (docs/specification/provider.md#what-the-schema-adds-to-the-table).

stdio.description: A stdio server the host starts.

command.description: The argv that starts the server: an absolute or home-relative executable, then its arguments, never a credential (docs/specification/profiles.md#no-secret-in-a-command-line).

env.description: Environment for the server; each value is a secret reference, secret-ref:NAME, never the secret (docs/specification/provider.md#semantic-rules).

scope.description: DEC-0044, LC-19. Where a host starts this stdio server. project: for the sessions of a project that binds it, from that project's MCP configuration. on-demand (the default when absent): for the run that binds it, stopped when that run ends. session: in every session; spelled so that FAC-SEM-056 refuses it by name.

url.description: A loopback Streamable HTTP endpoint, http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp, that the provider already serves.

source.description: Where the provider's code comes from.

installedAt.description: When the entry was written, an RFC 3339 UTC instant.

installedBy.description: Who or what installed the provider, 1 to 200 characters.

extensions.description: Vendor data, keyed by an absolute URI (docs/specification/overview.md#extension-rule).
